item.title: Chicago Bulls forward Matas Buzelis and Team Vince win Rising Stars event at NBA All-Star weekend
item.description: Chicago Bulls forward Matas Buzelis, making his third straight Rising Stars appearance, scored six points in the semifinal and four in the final for Team Vince, which won the event Friday night.

item.title: Asking Eric: I feel policed and judged
item.description: Dear Eric: My husband and I enjoy marijuana now that it has been legalized in our state. Lately, when our adult child has been over to visit and we step away to share a joint, they'll comment "I thought you only smoked on these days" or something to that extent.
